A first sweep flagged this direction and the drone is about to commit its remaining battery to it, so judge it carefully: is a real human body part clearly recognisable here? YES for anything with unmistakable human form and proportion even if only part of it is in frame or it is at the edge -- bare legs, feet, a hand, an arm, a torso, a head. NO for people on screens, posters, photos and mirrors.
